p.title: Sign in with your own browser
p.why: Google and some other sign-in providers block sign-in inside apps. You can sign in with your normal browser instead and paste the session here.
p.step1: Sign in to chatgpt.com in your usual browser (Chrome, Edge, …).
p.step3: Select all (Ctrl+A), copy (Ctrl+C) and paste it below.
p.warn: This works like your password: never share it. It is stored encrypted on this computer only. When it expires, paste it again.
p.bad: That doesn't look like the session page. Paste the whole page from chatgpt.com/api/auth/session (it should contain "accessToken")
p.expired: That session has already expired. Reload the page in your browser and copy it again
p.memoryOnly: (Encryption unavailable on this system, so it is kept only until you quit.)

h.note: Stored only on this computer for 8 days. Gaps mean the app wasn't running.
